title: Coordinated artists’ demonstrations for cultural work/reopening

execution.observed: Executed Oct 18; Lusa report and A Nação report name related island sites.

location.observed: Sal organizer origin; Praia count; associated São Vicente and Boa Vista, with Santo Antão canceled/planned only.

participants.observed: Sal >100 musicians and relatives; Praia about 20 musicians; no other island counts; no aggregation.

demands.observed: Relief from COVID restrictions affecting cultural work and reopening of cultural venues; domestic authorities.

state_response.observed: Unknown; earlier government announcement preceded the action and is not response.

violence.observed: Unknown; no supported explicit statement used.

locations: Sal; Praia, Santiago; associated actions on São Vicente and Boa Vista; reported national coordination from Sal; Santo Antão planned then canceled
participant_evidence: More than 100 musicians and relatives on Sal; about 20 musicians in Praia. No counts for São Vicente or Boa Vista; no count transferred.
notes: Do not aggregate site counts, forecasts, workforce or bystander totals. Provisional writer coding only; no independent scientific reviewer or official baseline mapping.

title: SINCOP hiace drivers’ protest day against COVID passenger-capacity rules

execution.observed: Action reported as held on Oct 19; A Nação report confirms event at Sucupira and simultaneous union actions; PANA describes protest day.

participants.observed: Qualitative “dozens” at Praia only; not secure for 50; unknown at other sites.

demands.observed: Reverse government COVID passenger limits; municipal terminal concerns also mentioned.

state_response.observed: Police organized traffic. Whether that was directed at dispersing the demonstration is not established; all response categories remain unknown.

participant_evidence: Unknown; A Nação describes “dozens” at Praia, which does not securely resolve whether attendance reached 50; other locations unquantified. Do not use 630 vehicles or 7,000 workforce as attendance.
notes: Do not aggregate site counts, forecasts, workforce or bystander totals. Provisional writer coding only; no independent scientific reviewer or official baseline mapping.
